title: Outlives bounds for projections are broken when used with generators/closures
body:
I tried this code: https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=nightly&mode=debug&edition=2021&gist=776e25cac316cad8c1ee83508ceb7f69 ```rust fn opaque(_: F) -> impl Iterator { b"".iter() } fn assert_static(_: T) {} fn generic_fn() { // proving ` as Iterator>::Item: 'static` // somehow requires `T: 'static`. assert_static(opaque(async {}).next()); //~^ the associated type `::Item` may not live long enough assert_static(opaque(|| {}).next()); //~^ the associated type `::Item` may not live long enough } ``` Both asserts don't pass. Adding `` bound on `generic_fn` makes it compile. We are requiring *all* the `Substs` for closures and generators to outlive `'static` here: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/9fed13030c2a2ebd79bfb1fd8be4f768cbe8c9d9/compiler/rustc_infer/src/infer/outlives/verify.rs#L77 This is wrong and inconsistent with the logic in [fn compute_components<'tcx>(](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/9fed13030c2a2ebd79bfb1fd8be4f768cbe8c9d9/compiler/rustc_infer/src/infer/outlives/components.rs#L62) ### Meta Build using the Nightly version: 1.63.0-nightly (2022-05-24 76761db5919b6d2e178b)
